versions.changelog:
- Initial release of geekbi-mercadolibre-review-search-skill.
- Enables users to search and analyze real Mercado Libre product reviews using a specific product or item ID.
- Supports extracting ratings, review text, image links, helpfulness, and timestamps from collected reviews.
- Clearly outlines process requirements, boundaries, and analysis methodology for review research.
- Provides default output including summary, data scope, rating distribution, themes, highlights, pain points, and improvement actions.
